title: The Torah and Tanakh — Tradition Overview (Edition 1)
description: The Tanakh comprises the Torah, the five books of Moses, Nevi'im, the prophets, and Ketuvim, the writings. The Talmud records rabbinic interpretation and law across centuries. This overview edition presents The Torah and Tanakh within the world's religious landscape, factually and without favor.
